+import pytest
+
+from wtforms.fields import StringField
+from wtforms.form import Form
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sequence_type", [list, tuple])
+def test_extra_filters_are_reusable(sequence_type):
+    def declared(value):
+        return value + "|declared"
+
+    def supplied(value):
+        return value + "|supplied"
+
+    class F(Form):
+        a = StringField(default="start", filters=[declared])
+
+        def filter_a(self, value):
+            return value + "|inline"
+
+    sequence = sequence_type([supplied])
+    extras = {"a": sequence}
+    form = F(extra_filters=extras)
+    assert form.a.data == "start|declared|supplied|inline"
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
+    assert extras["a"] is sequence
+
+    form.process(a="again", extra_filters=extras)
+    assert form.a.data == "again|declared|supplied|inline"
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
+    assert extras["a"] is sequence
+
+    other = F(extra_filters=extras)
+    assert other.a.data == "start|declared|supplied|inline"
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("sequence_type", [list, tuple])
+def test_extra_validators_are_reusable(sequence_type):
+    events = []
+
+    def declared(form, field):
+        events.append("declared")
+
+    def supplied(form, field):
+        events.append("supplied")
+
+    class F(Form):
+        a = StringField(validators=[declared])
+
+        def validate_a(self, field):
+            events.append("inline")
+
+    sequence = sequence_type([supplied])
+    extras = {"a": sequence}
+    form = F(a="value")
+    assert form.validate(extra_validators=extras)
+    assert events == ["declared", "supplied", "inline"]
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
+    assert extras["a"] is sequence
+
+    events.clear()
+    assert form.validate(extra_validators=extras)
+    assert events == ["declared", "supplied", "inline"]
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
+    assert extras["a"] is sequence
+
+    events.clear()
+    other = F(a="other")
+    assert other.validate(extra_validators=extras)
+    assert events == ["declared", "supplied", "inline"]
+    assert extras == {"a": sequence_type([supplied])}
